title: ABPL: A Cinematic Redesign
question: Choose the public site's new composition. Every option keeps ABPL content, the logo, the admin dashboard, and accessible motion.

options.label: Courtside Cinema
options.lineage: Arena entrances, courtside photography, and the immersive scenes in your reels
options.thesis: Enter the world of badminton before reading about the league.
options.viewport: A full-width court fills the opening. A large dimensional shuttle crosses the scene beside ABPL's title and a clear league link. Scrolling moves the camera into the league story.
options.risk: The scene must remain legible on phones and degrade to a composed still without WebGL.

raised.raise: The shuttle's diagonal flight connects the opening scene to the next section.
A repeatable image-and-type grammar carries the quieter inner pages.
Navigation and text retain clear boundaries over the spatial scene.
The 3D silhouette must be recognizable even without decorative effects.
Pointer response settles naturally and never creates an idle render loop.
Motion is choreographed as one sequence, with obvious pause and reduced-motion behavior.

options.label: Matchnight Broadcast
options.lineage: Sports broadcast openings and arena title graphics
options.thesis: Present the league with the pace and clarity of a televised sports opening.
options.viewport: A wide action image, large league title, and fast typographic cuts lead into a structured league overview. The shuttle is a supporting object rather than the primary scene.
options.risk: Clear and familiar, but closer to a conventional sports campaign than the spatial reels.

options.label: Shuttle Flight Plate
options.lineage: Pulp rocketship illustration translated to shuttle flight
options.thesis: Follow a shuttle's diagonal flight through an illustrated league story.
options.viewport: A diagonal shuttle illustration and title dominate a single poster-like plate.
options.case: Weaker sports identification and content clarity than a real court scene; the retro treatment diverges from the reels.
options.risk: Illustration can make the professional league feel like a fictional story.

options.label: League Motion Identity
options.thesis: Organize league stories through bold colored bands and sports photography.
options.viewport: An action photograph sits underneath large, modular blocks of league information.
options.case: The graphic identity competes with the requested immersive sporting scene and makes the content feel like an agency portfolio.
options.kept: A repeatable system across every public route.
options.risk: Multiple saturated bands can overwhelm the retained ABPL identity.

options.label: Arena Window
options.thesis: Read league content through a precise grid of photographic panes.
options.viewport: The court and league stories appear in an organized window-like grid.
options.case: The panes fragment the scene and return to the boxed composition the user wants to leave behind.
options.kept: Strong separation between controls and image detail.
options.risk: Can read as a dashboard rather than a sports experience.

options.label: Feather Structure
options.thesis: Use a close study of the shuttle's feather structure as the primary experience.
options.viewport: An enlarged feather structure floats above compact league information.
options.case: Equipment abstraction obscures both the league identity and its public content.
options.risk: Can feel like an industrial-design study instead of ABPL.

options.label: Rally Currents
options.thesis: Let pointer motion shape a fluid surface behind league content.
options.viewport: Pointer-driven currents fill the page around the league title.
options.case: Fluid effects do not communicate badminton and reduce clarity without adding product meaning.
options.risk: GPU cost would be spent on an unrelated visual metaphor.

options.label: Rally Sequence
options.thesis: Sequence league chapters through a tactile row of illuminated steps.
options.viewport: A step-row interface selects league chapters over a court photograph.
options.case: The control metaphor suggests a music tool and obscures normal site navigation.
options.kept: One deliberate rhythm with explicit motion controls.
options.risk: Unfamiliar navigation introduces work without helping visitors explore ABPL.

canonCard.label: Conventional League Website
canonCard.thesis: A standard sports website with polished photography and navigation.
canonCard.viewport: A familiar title and image hero leads into league information.
canonCard.risk: Less immersive than the supplied references.
